# ci/cd: dependabot: change commit message

Make Dependabot's commits follow the repository's conventions. **Motivation:** "to be precise" — the [`commit-message` options](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/dependabot/dependabot-version-updates/configuration-options-for-the-dependabot.yml-file#commit-message) allow a prefix per ecosystem: `deps:` for submodule bumps, `deps: tools:` (or `tools: deps:`) for the Go module in `/toolset/`, in the spirit of [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/). Related to the same change in the author's Go template, [octomation/go-module#65](https://github.com/octomation/go-module/issues/65).
